title: SAFESORA: Towards Safety Alignment of Text2Video Generation via a Human Preference Dataset
reasoning: The paper introduces a human preference dataset specifically designed to align text-to-video models with human values, using the 3H (Helpful, Harmless, Honest) ethical standards. It includes detailed benchmarking for 12 harm categories such as racial discrimination, terrorism, and sensitive social issues, explicitly framing the evaluation within human moral and ethical standards.
